reviews.review_text:
yapasproblemix
Hạ Long Bay, Vietnam34 contributions
0
Great fried steak, salad. I'll try pizza next time.
Oct 2024 • Friends
On 14 years of regular presence in Vietnam as an entrepreneur, Emms is one of my favorite restaurants, I already loved Emm's from the beginning, when I knew the restaurant 3 or 4 years ago, but there I just returned yesterday and again today after a long time and what was not my surprise. Emm's is even better than before.

The goal of my post is that more people know the restaurant to feast. 
I will not be able to give you a methodical and complete "rating". Just tell you what I felt and what went through my mind about the 2 lunches I had yesterday and today:
1. It's too good, the setting is super warm, authentic, I want to encourage my friends to come and eat there
2. It's great that they added pizzas, so I'll try them soon. They look as good as in my favorite pizza restaurants and I know almost all of them (pizza4, Vinci, pizza hut, alfresco, pizza company etc....)
3. There's brunch at 180k, I feel like I'll come every day
4. They have completely changed the rates, it is much cheaper and yet I have the Impression that it is even better than before.
5. Why go eat in steak restaurants not authentic and more expensive when here it's good and really affordable

Yesterday I ate fried steak and a glass of red wine (I don't know much restaurant where wine by the glass is good). 
Today the same fried steak, salad, beer, chocolate mousse. Everything was excellent.

May 2024 • Couples
Emm's French Bistro in Hanoi offers a beautiful culinary experience, blending French elegance and Vietnamese hospitality. The decoration is chic and intimate, perfect for a romantic dinner or an evening with friends. The dishes prepared are authentic and carefully presented. The burata and wagyu beef steak were a treat. Lots of choice of good wines by the glass.
The service is attentive, A real little piece of France in Hanoi.

Hanoi, Vietnam16 contributions

Great design and delicious food
Sep 2019 • Family
First time visit of EMM’s bistro at Do Quang with my wife. I went there because I have bee to the first EMM’s cafe several times and always had great food, service and a nice ambiance. The design of the new Restaurant is beautiful and elegant. Great setting for lunch or dinner. My wife likes steak and took the ribeye and I ordered the pancetta risotto. We shared a plate of tomato bruschetta together. Steak was good quality beef and perfectly cooked. Nice hand cut fries and a small salad came with the steak. I love risotto and the pancetta risotto was super crispy (the pancetta) and flavorful. 

Nice service staff who are caring and friendly. I would definitely recommend the new EMM’s for anyone interested in good food and a nice time out.
